question: Show me the 17 February 2018 telecom infrastructure policy GR.
gold_answer: Not in this corpus. (The corpus's GR of 17-02-2018 is a different one: a tender evaluation committee for consultants.) It is cited by the GRs of 03-03-2018, 08-07-2019, 07-06-2021 and 04-11-2022, and the policy was revised by the telecom infrastructure policy GR of 04-11-2022

gold_grs_detail.title: Action related to the establishment and maintenance of Tele-communication Infrastructure in the state till implementation of online portal.

product.answer: I couldn't find a GR on telecom infrastructure policy dated 17 February 2018 in the corpus. The corpus contains a GR dated 17-02-2018 (201802171427235111) titled 'Tender Evaluation Committee for Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra.', which is unrelated. The actual telecom infrastructure policy is referenced by later GRs (e.g., 202211041809363311 dated 04-11-2022 and 201907111447186811 dated 08-07-2019) as Government Resolution No. मातंसं०६५/प्र.क्र.१/२०१८, dated 17.02.2018, but its full text is not provided in the retrieved set.

product.answer: The current rule, as amended by GR dated 08-07-2019, includes IP-1 institutions and roof top towers under mobile towers in the telecom infrastructure policy. Earlier, the 17 February 2018 GR (Tender Evaluation Committee for Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra) only constituted a Tender Evaluation Committee for empanelment of consultants and did not cover telecom infrastructure policy contents.
